name: Everybody Step Aside, the Matriarch Is Back
original_name: Everybody Step Aside, the Matriarch Is Back
overview:
She ruled America's most powerful dynasty—until they tried to bury her. Left for dead, Selena Orlando wakes with no memory, trapped in a nightmare marriage to a family beneath her. Every day is survival. Every night, rage she can't explain.

One brutal fight changes everything. Her memories flood back.

She takes her daughter and walks—no hesitation, no mercy. Then fate delivers Edward Randall, billionaire heir to an empire, straight into her arms. Their marriage is lightning. Her agenda is ice-cold.

Hidden behind the Randall name, Selena hunts the traitors who destroyed her. When the mask drops, so do the bodies. This isn't a comeback. It's a reckoning.

They stole her crown. She'll burn their kingdoms to ash.
